newsitem.title: USA: Slovenia to seek up to 50,000 tonnes wheat - trade.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia to seek up to 50,000 tonnes wheat - trade.

text.p: Slovenia is expected early this week to tender for 40,000 to 50,000 tonnes of Canadian or U.S. wheat, several U.S. exporters said.
The wheat could be either U.S. hard red spring wheat or Canadian wheat of some type, one U.S. exporter said.
"I understand it to be 40,000 tonnes. They (Slovenia) will look at Canadian wheat as an option," one exporter said. Arrival was slated for February 28, that source said.
But a second U.S. exporter said the shipment was for some spot arrival. "They (Slovenia) are tendering this week," he said.
